plain.li: Had to go behind the woodpile again.
Went out past the fields to relieve myself, and took the long way back so I wouldn't have to explain.
[winter] Squatted in the snow this morning. My legs still haven't warmed up.
[night] Went out in the dark to relieve myself and heard something moving in the brush. I didn't stay long.
[child] I had to go in the bushes, and the leaves were prickly.

warm.li: Went out behind the storeroom at dawn. Not the worst view of the sunrise, I'll admit.

blunt.li: Bushes again. We need somewhere to go.

cheerful.li: Went in the bushes and found wild berries on the way back.

gloomy.li: Squatting in the open like an animal. This is what we've come to.

cold.li: Waste left in the open. It will draw flies, and the flies will find the kitchen.

plain.li: Didn't make it in time today. Washed my pants out and said nothing to anyone.
An accident on the way to the latrine. I'd rather not write more than that.
[old] My body doesn't give me as much warning as it used to. Today it gave me none.
[child] I had an accident. I didn't want anybody to see.

warm.li: Had an accident today. The one who found me fetched water and never said a word about it.

blunt.li: Didn't make it. Not talking about it.

cheerful.li: Had an accident. Clean clothes now, and I'm walking with my head up.

gloomy.li: Soiled myself, at my age. I hid until dark.

cold.li: Too far from a toilet, and too much work to leave. Next time the work can wait.

plain.li: Somebody walked in while I was washing. We both said sorry about four times.
Got walked in on at the latrine. There's no door, so I can't even blame them.
Somebody saw me in the bath. I'm going to bathe at night from now on.
[child] Someone came in while I was in the bath and I yelled at them.

warm.li: Got walked in on while I was washing. We laughed about it afterward, mostly.

cheerful.li: Someone walked in on my bath. I'm choosing to find it funny.

gloomy.li: There's no privacy here. Not even for that.

cold.li: Interrupted while washing. A door between the tubs would end it.

plain.li: Hot bath tonight. Sat in it until the water went lukewarm.
The water was properly hot this morning. Best wash in weeks.
[winter] A hot bath on a day like this. I could feel my toes again afterward.
[afterraid] Soaked the raid out of my shoulders in hot water.
[child] I had a hot bath and stayed in until my fingers went wrinkly.

warm.li: Had my hot bath, then left the water for the next person while it was still warm.

cheerful.li: Hot bath! I may never get out.

gloomy.li: A hot bath. For a while I forgot everything else.

cold.li: Hot water loosens the back. I'll work better tomorrow.

plain.li: [good] A cold wash this morning. Woke me up better than anything.
[good,hot] Rinsed off in cold water after work. Just what I needed in this heat.
[bad] No hot water again. I washed in about ten seconds.
[bad,winter] The water was so cold it hurt. I'm not sure I'm any cleaner.
[good,child] The water was cold and I squealed, but it was fun.
[bad,child] The bath was freezing. I got out as fast as I could.

warm.li: [good] Cold water first thing. It cleared my head.
[bad] The water was ice cold. Next time I'll warm a pot on the fire for whoever comes after me.

cheerful.li: [good] A cold splash to start the day!
[bad] Freezing bath, but I'm clean, so it counts.

gloomy.li: [good] Cold water. At least it woke me up.
[bad] Washed in water cold enough to stop a heart.

cold.li: [bad] No hot water. Somebody let the fire go out.

plain.li: [bad] Haven't washed in days. I can smell myself when I lean over the workbench.
[bad] My hair's stiff with dirt. I keep my hat on.
[bad,hot] We all smell in this heat, and I smell worst.
[good] Washed properly today. Clean shirt, clean hands.
[good] Scrubbed myself pink this morning.
[good,child] I had a bath and now I smell like soap.
[bad,child] I'm dirty all over and I don't want a bath.

warm.li: [good] Clean at last. I lent my comb to whoever wanted it.
[bad] I'm grimy, but so are the others on my shift. We stink together.

cheerful.li: [bad] I'm filthy, but it's honest dirt.

gloomy.li: [bad] I smell like the latrine. Maybe I just live there now.

cold.li: [good] Clean. People are easier to deal with when you don't smell.
[bad] Dirty. It's starting to cost me in conversations.

plain.li: The water tasted wrong today. I was too thirsty to care.
Drank water that smelled of the latrine. My stomach's been grumbling since.
[hot] It was so hot I drank whatever I could find. I'm trying not to think about where it came from.
[child] The water tasted like dirt.

warm.li: The water's gone bad somewhere. I warned the others before they drank any.

cheerful.li: Drank some questionable water. Still standing!

gloomy.li: I drank things today I won't write down.

cold.li: Dirty water. Someone will get sick from it before long.

plain.li: [good] Washed in my own bathroom this morning. Door shut, no line.
[good] No one else's hair in the basin. I could get used to this.
[bad] My bathroom is a dark, damp hole. I wash as fast as I can.
[bad] The bathroom stinks, and the floor is still bare dirt.

warm.li: [good] I put a plant in my bathroom. It's doing well in the damp.
[bad] Tidied my bathroom tonight. It needs more than tidying.

cheerful.li: [good] Sang in the bath with the door shut, as loud as I liked.
[bad] My bathroom's grim. I sing louder to make up for it.

gloomy.li: [good] A fine bathroom. The finest thing I have.

cold.li: [good] A good bathroom. Worth what it cost.
[bad] The bathroom is substandard. I've seen better at a roadside inn.

plain.li: Spent the afternoon needing to go, with no time to. The work wouldn't wait.
There was a line for the latrine again. I held on.
[night] Lay awake needing to go and not wanting to walk out in the dark.
[child] I needed to go really badly and somebody was in there.

warm.li: Let someone go ahead of me in the line. Regretted it within the minute.

blunt.li: Too few latrines. Too many people.

cheerful.li: Held it all afternoon. A personal record.

gloomy.li: Bursting all day, and the line never moved.

cold.li: Time spent waiting in line is time not working.
